_meta.note: Every container the plugin can emit at the top level of a reading, where nothing of ours is painted behind it. `surfaces` carry text and therefore paint their own background AND foreground; `passthrough` carry none of their own. Two enforcers read this one list: bin/check-frontend-contrast.mjs proves each surface paints both halves and clears AA in both modes against a hostile theme, and tests/phpunit/test-painted-surfaces.php proves rendered output opens with nothing that is not listed here. The value is the file that emits the class, checked so a rename cannot leave either enforcer measuring markup that no longer ships.
